body.x: FaceCake Marketing Technologies to Showcase FrameWizard(TM) Digital Frame and Photo Animation Software at CES 2010
Visit FaceCake Marketing Technologies in Booth#31542, South Hall 3 Upper Level to Preview the First Digital Frame that Makes Still Photos Move
PR Newswire
CALABASAS, Calif., Jan. 7

CALABASAS, Calif., Jan. 7 /PRNewswire/ -- FaceCake Marketing Technologies, Inc. will premiere its interactive photo animation software and state-of-the-art frame—the only product of its kind—at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, Nevada, January 7–10. Using patented, easy-to-use software, FrameWizard™ creates an interactive experience through which consumers can transform ordinary photos into one-of-a-kind animated images. By downloading the software onto a computer, users are able to create lifelike movement in people and pets, add animated seasonal or occasional effects, change photo backdrops and design personalized digital mattes in mere minutes.

"The FrameWizard™ allows users to make their still photos move with lifelike animations and effects that evoke the nostalgia of their memories," said Linda Smith, President and CEO. "Children smiling and laughing, a pet panting and wagging its tail, gentle snow on a winter landscape—the FrameWizard™ creates magical moving memories to relive every day."

Pioneering new territory in the digital frame market, FrameWizard™ is available for purchase at www.framewizard.com and will be sold by major retailers and online at Amazon.com, to deliver the newest must-have gadget. Sleek and functional, the frame is constructed from sculptural, versatile black wood to complement any home or office decor, and includes Pro Edition software compatible with both PC and Mac® computers. The suggested retail price for the 8-inch frame is $199.99, and $299.99 for the 15-inch model. FaceCake Marketing Technologies also offers a 7-inch frame, which includes Starter Edition software for only $149.99.

The FrameWizard™ Pro Edition software features four trademarked software components: Moving Memories™, Element Effects™, Change of Scenery™ and Matte Magic™. FrameWizard™ Starter Edition software, included with the 7-inch model, features Element Effects™ and Matte Magic™.
Moving Memories™

Imagine children moving and blinking, a bride and groom smiling, or even the family dog playfully wagging his tail. The magic of Moving Memories™ dazzles and delights as still photos transform into memories in motion.
Element Effects™

Infuse photos with the natural wonder of swirling autumn leaves, the drama of a lightning storm, the serenity of a twinkling starry night and much more. Or, set a festive mood with balloons or confetti.
Change of Scenery™

Take memories to exciting new destinations. Replace photo backgrounds and place loved ones in tranquil landscape settings, set the scene with animated environments or choose stunning moving panoramas.
Matte Magic™
Design a one-of-a-kind border to coordinate with your home or office decor. Choose from themed, occasional or seasonal styles, or upload an image to create a custom matte.
For more information on FrameWizard™ visit www.framewizard.com.
About FaceCake Marketing Technologies, Inc.

FaceCake Marketing Technologies, Inc. is a pioneer and innovator in personalized interactive marketing. FaceCake's proprietary Visual Demonstration Software (VDS) allows users to manipulate their own images, with a wide range of image transformation and animation capabilities, to try on and try out various products and services. The VDS in conjunction with FaceCake patented mirror image marketing solution provides user-specific, highly targeted promotion of products on user images, for unprecedented levels of personalization. FaceCake interactive solutions are available across multiple platforms including Internet, mobile, social media, retail kiosk and iTV. FaceCake is headquartered in Calabasas, California.
